rationale: The IAM users page is already covered by usersOrg.spec.js (add/edit/delete/validation CRUD) and iam-form-validation.spec.js (Add User email/role form validation). Neither covers the diff's actual regression surface: the role summary strip (user-summary-role-* / user-summary-total tiles), the role facet filter, and the RBAC gating change that skips the custom-roles fetch + hides the custom-role field in OSS. These are small, focused scenarios in the same feature area, so appending new test() cases to the existing Users and Organizations spec (reusing its imports, describe block, and pm.userPage) is the least-duplicative choice. A brand-new usersRbacCustomRoles.spec.js (the triage's suggested path) would either duplicate the CRUD flows or live as a thin standalone file, so it is superseded by this append. No new registration needed since usersOrg.spec.js is already in the GeneralTests shard.
